messages:
morgan: deploy-bot just fired an alert for cross-region rollout. It's about to auto-revert in ~5m. Quick read?
deploy-bot: ALERT: multi-region rollout (us-west1 + eu-central) p95 deviation + error spike detected. p95 up +180ms, 5xxs 2.8% over 3m. Auto-revert scheduled in 5m. Use /deploybot ack to suppress.
morgan: I'd prefer human-in-the-loop here. If it's a config regression we should do a targeted region rollback, not global. Rhea, can you check control-slice and recent config diffs?
rhea: looking now. Control-slice shows the regression is concentrated in eu-central, us-west1 looks noisy but within thresholds. Config diff: a batch heuristic param changed in the same commit.
ishaan: If the regression is regional, we should suppress auto-revert and run region-scoped rollback for eu-central first. That lets us keep us-west1 stable. Also notify Dedicated account owners for eu region.
morgan: good. I'll ack suppression and own EU rollback. Command: ```/deploybot ack suppress --thread 1743129999 --by morgan --reason "investigate regional regression; staged rollback plan" --until 2026-04-12T18:30:00Z```
deploy-bot: CONFIRMED: suppression acked by morgan until 2026-04-12T18:30:00Z (suppression id sup-c9e1). Monitoring continues.
rhea: quick trace shows large request batches hitting new heuristic causing queueing. Candidate rollback target: v6.0.7.
ellen: I'll prepare a short customer note for two Dedicated tenants (Nimbus & DataWorks) in eu region. Keep it short: one-liner and ETA.
ishaan: Rollout plan: staged rollback eu-central 10% -> 40% -> 100% with 5m steps. Watch kvcache warming and any schema compatibility warnings.
morgan: execute: ```/deploybot rollout set-version --region eu-central --version v6.0.7 --traffic 10% --staged --step-duration 300s --thread 1743129999```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Initiated staged rollback to v6.0.7 in eu-central. Step 1: 10% -> monitoring.
rhea: after 10% p95 dropped from 420ms -> 195ms, 5xxs 0.5%. KV miss spike ~short-lived. Looks good to proceed.
morgan: continue to 40%: ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 40% --thread 1743129999```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Advanced to 40% at 2026-04-12T18:06:12Z.
ellen: notified Nimbus and DataWorks reps; they acknowledged and asked for final ETA. I'll post a concise message after 100% complete.
ishaan: telemetry steady at 40%: p95 185ms, 5xx 0.2%. Move to 100%. ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 100% --thread 1743129999```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Rollback to v6.0.7 completed to 100% in eu-central at 2026-04-12T18:14:10Z. Telemetry: p95 170ms, 5xx 0.1%.
morgan: pin eu-central to v6.0.7 for 24h and add a release-note blurb to the release ticket: reason = batch-heuristic regression. ```/deploybot pin-version --region eu-central --version v6.0.7 --duration 24h```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Pin applied for 24h.
rhea: I'll open a postmortem ticket and include trace links + suppression id sup-c9e1. Also add a remediation to include token-size distribution in deploy-bot thresholds.
ishaan: add runbook step: when suppressing auto-revert, always set an owner, a TTL, and execute region-scoped rollback first if telemetry localized.
morgan: agreed. ops-bot, create follow-up items: postmortem, runbook PR, and release-notes update.
ops-bot: ACTION: Created tickets: PM-4321 (postmortem), DOCS-219 (runbook PR), RELNOTES-87 (release note update). Links: https://tracker/PM-4321 https://tracker/DOCS-219 https://tracker/RELNOTES-87
morgan: great work. Short retro in 1h to capture lessons and adjust deploy-bot thresholds. :thumbsup:
